metadata.question: Was the PM2.5 level higher in February 2020 than in February 2019 within a 50km radius of (40.923221, 104.238631)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use the SEDAC Global 3-Year Running Mean PM2.5 Gridded 0.01 deg dataset (V5.GL.03) – it has annual composites for each calendar year (2019, 2020). Collection ID: “COLUMBIA/ac4_pm25_global_monthly_v5_GL03” (band: “b1” = PM2.5 µg/m³). Time: 2019-02-01 → 2019-02-28 and 2020-02-01 → 2020-02-28 (each annual image covers the whole year, but we simply pick the image whose nominal start is that year). 2. Masking strategy: No clouds to mask – PM2.5 is a gridded product. 3. Logic: Compute average PM2.5 inside a 50 km radius buffer of the point for Feb 2019 and Feb 2020 images. If either collection is empty → C1. If any reduceRegion returns 0 valid pixels → C2. If mean is None/NaN → C3. Otherwise compare: if 2020 mean > 2019 mean → A, else → B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time loc = ee.Geometry.Point([104.238631, 40.923221]) buffer = loc.buffer(50000) start19, end19 = '2019-02-01', '2019-02-28' start20, end20 = '2020-02-01', '2020-02-28' # 2. Data acquisition col19 = ee.ImageCollection('COLUMBIA/ac4_pm25_global_monthly_v5_GL03')\ .filterDate(start19, end19)\ .select('b1') col20 = ee.ImageCollection('COLUMBIA/ac4_pm25_global_monthly_v5_GL03')\ .filterDate(start20, end20)\ .select('b1') if col19.size().getInfo() == 0 or col20.size().getInfo() == 0: print("Empty collection for one or both years.") print("C1") # 3. Processing & validation img19 = col19.first() img20 = col20.first() count19 = img19.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=buffer, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('b1').getInfo() count20 = img20.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=buffer, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('b1').getInfo() if count19 == 0 or count20 == 0: print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") mean19 = img19.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=buffer, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('b1').getInfo() mean20 = img20.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=buffer, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('b1').getInfo() if mean19 is None or mean20 is None: print("Calculation failed.") print("C3") print(f"2019 PM2.5: {mean19:.2f} µg/m³ (pixels: {count19})") print(f"2020 PM2.5: {mean20:.2f} µg/m³ (pixels: {count20})") if mean20 > mean19: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
loc = ee.Geometry.Point([104.238631, 40.923221])
buffer = loc.buffer(50000)
start19, end19 = '2019-02-01', '2019-02-28'
start20, end20 = '2020-02-01', '2020-02-28'

# 2. Data acquisition
col19 = ee.ImageCollection('COLUMBIA/ac4_pm25_global_monthly_v5_GL03')\
           .filterDate(start19, end19)\
           .select('b1')
col20 = ee.ImageCollection('COLUMBIA/ac4_pm25_global_monthly_v5_GL03')\
           .filterDate(start20, end20)\
           .select('b1')

if col19.size().getInfo() == 0 or col20.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("Empty collection for one or both years.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 3. Processing & validation
img19 = col19.first()
img20 = col20.first()

count19 = img19.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                             geometry=buffer, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('b1').getInfo()
count20 = img20.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                             geometry=buffer, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('b1').getInfo()
if count19 == 0 or count20 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

mean19 = img19.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                            geometry=buffer, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('b1').getInfo()
mean20 = img20.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                            geometry=buffer, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('b1').getInfo()

if mean19 is None or mean20 is None:
    print("Calculation failed.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")

print(f"2019 PM2.5: {mean19:.2f} µg/m³ (pixels: {count19})")
print(f"2020 PM2.5: {mean20:.2f} µg/m³ (pixels: {count20})")

if mean20 > mean19:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
